description: The license of every file of the ECL-1 repository. The rules apply in order, and the first rule whose package and paths match a file decides its class. A rule's package is public (the files of the standard's public repository), platform (G-14's own implementation, which is not part of it) or any. In a glob, ** matches any number of path segments and * matches within one segment.
